items.question: What is Crafters and who is it best for?
items.answer: Crafters is a minimal luxury jewelry brand designed for fashion-forward Gen Z girls who want high-quality, beautifully crafted pieces at accessible prices. We specialize in necklaces, rings, bracelets, and earrings that blend timeless elegance with contemporary style. Our pieces are perfect for anyone who values quality craftsmanship and wants jewelry that tells their story.

items.question: What materials does Crafters use in its jewelry?
items.answer: We use premium materials including 18k rose gold vermeil, 14k gold fill, sterling silver, freshwater pearls, and cubic zirconia stones. Each piece is carefully crafted to ensure durability and longevity. Our materials are ethically sourced and designed to maintain their beauty with proper care, offering the luxury look without the luxury price tag.

items.question: How does Crafters ensure quality and authenticity?
items.answer: Every piece undergoes rigorous quality control before shipping. We work with certified artisans who hand-set stones and finish each item to our exacting standards. Our 4.9/5 average rating from 12,400+ verified customers reflects our commitment to excellence. We also offer a 30-day easy return policy so you can shop with confidence.

items.question: What is the pricing and do you offer discounts?
items.answer: Our pieces range from $28 to $115, with most bestsellers priced between $30–$70. We regularly offer seasonal sales like our Summer Glow Collection at 40% off. Free shipping is available on orders over $50. We believe luxury jewelry should be accessible, which is why we price our pieces 50–70% below comparable luxury brands.

items.question: What makes Crafters different from other jewelry brands?
items.answer: Crafters combines three key differentiators: minimal, timeless design that never goes out of style; premium materials at Gen Z–friendly prices; and fast, reliable shipping with 2–5 day delivery. Unlike fast-fashion jewelry, our pieces are built to last. We also prioritize sustainable sourcing and ethical production, ensuring your jewelry purchase aligns with your values.

footer.tagline: Minimal luxury jewelry for the fashion-forward generation.
